descFull: Herdr and Rex mobile app for Android and iPhone. ColliePWA shows Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or pi on your phone: read the chat or the screen, reply by text or voice, get push alerts. Self-hosted PWA, no account, no app store. Herdr is fully supported; Rex, tmux and zellij are experimental.
